description: This file defines a custom exception class 'GroupMemberCountNotInPermissibleRangeException' used in the group management module of the project. It extends an abstract exception class and provides a constructor that formats an error message when the number of group members is outside a permissible range.

classes.name: GroupMemberCountNotInPermissibleRangeException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that the number of group members is outside the permissible range.

methods.name: GroupMemberCountNotInPermissibleRangeException
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with a specific message about the group's member count constraints.
